_comment: STAGE 1 of the two-stage curriculum: pristine gliner2.5-multi-v1 on REAL Turkish legal text (datasets/mixed/train_100000.jsonl = 50k KVKK + 50k NER rows, 30 labels, entities only), 13,000 steps (~0.52 epoch). Relations stay ENABLED in the head config: the data carries no relation supervision, so the pretrained relation head passes through untouched (enable_relations:false would freeze it dead). Stage 1 alone is unusable (57.9 entity / 0 relations on real docs); it is the grounding step for stage 2.
